name: duopore-public-timesheet-invoice-preparation
description: Turn your billable work hours into a clear list of charges for an invoice draft.

interface.longDescription: Turn your billable work hours into a clear list of charges for an invoice draft. Share time entries, client and project labels, and the rate for each entry. See billable charges grouped by client and project. Entries marked nonbillable stay out of the total. Review the maths before using it. Tax and expenses are not included, and no invoice is sent.
defaultPrompt: Turn these billable time entries into invoice charges.
Group my work hours and charges by client and project.

positive.prompt: Use Timesheet Invoice Prep with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"entries":[{"entryId":"01","client":"Alpha","project":"Launch","hours":1.5,"hourlyRate":80,"billable":true},{"entryId":"02","client":"Alpha","project":"Launch","hours":2,"hourlyRate":100,"billable":true},{"entryId":"03","client":"Alpha","project":"Launch","hours":1,"hourlyRate":80,"billable":false}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 client/project draft lines totaling 320.00.","rows":[{"client":"Alpha","project":"Launch","billableHours":3.5,"amount":320,"entries":2}],"warnings":["Draft only; excludes tax, expenses and nonbillable entries.","Rates must use one currency; each time entry is rounded to two decimals."]}
